column1: # How long each coverage gate took on a hosted Windows runner, in seconds, then its label.
# Read by scripts/coverage_gates.sh to deal the gates into shards of about equal length. A gate
# with no line here is taken to be of the middle length, so a new gate needs none. Each line is a
# run's own report of the gate, "PASS  coverage: <label>  (<seconds>s)", and the numbers only have
# to be roughly right: record them again when the shards have drifted apart.
